source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate && conda activate testbed && python3 << 'EOF'
import sympy as sp
from sympy.polys.orderings import monomial_key

x1, x2, x3 = sp.symbols('x1, x2, x3')
states = [x1, x2, x3]
monomials = sorted(sp.itermonomials(states, 4, min_degrees=3), key=monomial_key('grlex', states))
print(monomials)

from sympy.abc import x, y
print(sorted(sp.itermonomials([x, y], 2, 1), key=monomial_key('grlex', [y, x])))
print(sorted(sp.itermonomials([x, y], 2), key=monomial_key('grlex', [y, x])))
print(sorted(sp.itermonomials([x, y], 3), key=monomial_key('grlex', [y, x])))

a, b = sp.symbols('a, b', commutative=False)
print(set(sp.itermonomials([a, b, x], 2)))
EOF
